$meta.title: Universal Impossibility — the completeness theorem for the tamings
$meta.purpose: zoom-out index of the attack on universal impossibility; load first, follow detail pointers to leaf files. Sibling branch of the reconstruction/commensurability collection, spun off 2026-07-09 when the paper's 'ten stamps' problem was diagnosed as the missing completeness theorem.
$meta.what_is_it: Conjecture: the ten catalogued tamings are EXHAUSTIVE — no 'fork' (a language contextual on some gate-passing time-realisable frame yet escaping all ten mechanisms) exists. Equivalently: the winding criterion is a COMPLETE decision procedure and the reconstruction guarantee is unconditional.
$meta.status: OPEN — active attack (no half measures, user directive 2026-07-09). The paper needs this to complete: it converts 'ten sufficient conditions (a collection)' into 'one necessary-and-sufficient classification (a theorem)'. Until proved, the tamings honestly read as stamp-collecting BECAUSE their organizing theorem is unproved.
$meta.the_shape: The conjecture reduces along a chain: universal-impossibility ⟸ [Joint 1: pruning lemma, CLOSED all k this session] ∧ [Joint 2: exchange-blocking classification, OPEN]. Joint 2's crux, CORRECTED 2026-07-09, is NOT 'the non-symmetric case' (golden mean refuted that — its safety is signability/TU firing on the bipartite residue). The real crux: THE TAMINGS ARE THE ONLY SOURCES OF RESIDUE-SAFETY IN A PRIMITIVE LANGUAGE — i.e. classify sources of residue-safety, show each is a catalogued taming. That IS 'the tamings are complete'.

subtargets.name: Girth-locking / sources-of-safety — REDUCED to L-B (2026-07-09)
subtargets.one_line: The parity-only attack, carried to a clean reduction. ⚠ TWO wrong carriers dissolved along the way (confirmation-bias catches): (1) 'bipartite LAYERED ring' was a TAUTOLOGY (layered ring bipartite at every even L for every ρ via homomorphism onto C_L; 'bipartite⟹safe' FALSE — full relation cex). CORRECT object (VALIDATED, 1600 langs 0-mismatch): unsafe at L ⟺ a 2-fold cover of the layer cycle closes with SWAP MONODROMY after L steps ⟺ bar-D (unordered-pair graph) signed by monodromy+1 is UNBALANCED at length L. safe-on-evens ⟺ signed bar-D BALANCED (A=3 FULL 0-mismatch, not tautology). Reduced to L-B forcing lemma (see open_crux.forcing_lemma_LB). R1 backbone: ~25,700 primitives, 0 cex to safe⟹evens.

subtargets.name: Are potential/phase-code independent of grading? — RESOLVED: NO
subtargets.one_line: RESOLVED (verified by building): the triple COLLAPSES. phase-code = a Z_d labelling advanced by arcs = grading = imprimitivity, by definition. A monotone Z-potential on a strongly-connected digraph is CONSTANT (0/347 admit non-constant) ⟹ 'potential' is either grading (mod-d) or the already-catalogued monotone-collapse (taming 8). NO new third mechanism. Joint 2 has ONE crux, not three. PROBLEM SIZED.
